title: Pentaryn Wall Autocomplete
description: Deterministic completion of hand-drawn walls. Rough in the windows, doors and hint stubs; the engine infers the rest or refuses and says why. Ships a compiled (WASM) engine that is ~12x faster than the JS one and produces identical geometry, verified against the same fixture corpus. Exposes game.pentaryn.walls.preview() / .run() / .undo(). See context/foundry/walls.md.
